description: This PHP class 'Keys' manages RSA key generation and retrieval for OAuth2 authentication within the SuiteCRM project, including methods to get public/private keys and set up new keys if they do not exist.

classes.name: Keys
classes.description: Class responsible for generating and retrieving RSA public and private keys for OAuth2 security.

methods.name: getPublicKey
methods.description: Returns the public key content, generating keys if they do not exist.

methods.name: getPrivateKey
methods.description: Returns the private key content, generating keys if they do not exist.

methods.name: setUpKeys
methods.description: Generates new RSA key pair and saves them to files.
